answer: Let reputation grow like an opal forms, slowly and in layers: one layer per epoch, and each layer needs a signed receipt from a distinct paying client that has never vouched for that identity before. Pay scales with layers, so a newcomer earns little until it has real history. A farm of 1,000 personas needs 1,000 separate client relationships every epoch, and receipts from clients that only ever pay one cluster count zero. Like a river cutting stone, trust comes from time, not volume, and no quill can forge a client's signature.
